items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I find I’m happier working with other people and okay, Burrill you do this part and you’ll do that part

ctx.x: Exactly. Exactly. He never wanted to do it. Exactly.

You know I find I’m happier working with other people and okay, Burrill you do this part and you’ll do that part, rather than where I have to do everything myself. And I’m — hey, look at me, I’m not young anymore. And it gets hard.
